title: Trek
description: Bored of vanilla structure generation? This pack is for you!
author: hotsuop
body:
# Trek
**Version:** Beta 0.6.2

![Villager island](/launcher-preview/bodies/h2jngREY/0.webp)

Trek is a datapack that turns your Minecraft world into a treasure trove of discovery. Designed for explorers and builders, it adds over 150 custom structures across biomes, blending seamlessly into their environments, all while preserving vanilla gameplay.

### What Does Trek Add?
- Large structures, such as flying or water islands, pyramids, fortresses, mansions;
- Different houses, camps, ships, towers, ancient buildings;
- Or very small ones, like a pork, cooking on a campfire, or ruins remained as a sign, that structure has been there;
- Trek also overhauls **some** vanilla structures, ensuring that finding them will feel more exiting. We have plans of overhauling all vanilla structures in future.

### Features
- **Biome-Specific**: Jungle treehouses in rainforests, snowmans in taigas;
- **Weighted Spawning**: Rare finds like sunken cities feel special;
- **Vanilla-Friendly**: No mods, just a datapack;
- **Higly compatible**: List of compatibilities can be found on our [wiki](https://trek-2.gitbook.io/trek/compatibilities).

![Village at sunset](/launcher-preview/bodies/h2jngREY/1.webp)


### Why Download Trek?
Perfect for survivalists seeking challenges, nomads hunting ruins, or builders wanting inspiration. Sail to ocean islands, uncover frozen trees, or trade in lush savannas — all in vanilla Minecraft!

[![Ko-fi Button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/276e6f0c5acd4735f82da0219ef160a48e4cd843.gif 'Ko-fi Support Button')](https://ko-fi.com/hotsuop)

<small> *Donations help us to keep the mod up to date and develop new features! </small>

### Check out our [wiki](https://trek-2.gitbook.io/trek) for more information.

Enjoy your Trek adventure!

# Minor mc version compatibility update
## Technical part
- Datapack divided back into 2 separate packs for 1.19-1.20.6 and 1.21-26.1.2, Which results in:
- Error `Couldn't load file/Trek.zip pack metadata: Multi-version packs cannot support minimum version of less than 15, since this will leave versions in range unable to load pack.` should not appear anymore
- Fixed incompatibility with newer neoforge versions ([Issue #26](https://github.com/hotsu0p/Trek-Issues/issues/26))
- Overall datapack size is halved

# Vanilla structures update. Part 1: Vanilla Villages
## Technical part
- Updated Trek to support 1.21.6-1.21.8 too
- Villages spawns a lot less WILD now and blends in better
- Fixed a lot of bugs with village generation ([Issue #5](https://github.com/hotsu0p/Trek-Issues/issues/5))
- Adjusted rarity of villages, now they spawn a little rarer
- Added processors to village streets
- Decreased overall size of villages
- Moved villages from `minecraft` to `trek` folder for better compatibility ([Issue #6](https://github.com/hotsu0p/Trek-Issues/issues/6))
- Replaced functional blocks in villages ([Issue #7](https://github.com/hotsu0p/Trek-Issues/issues/7))
- Temporary removed swamp and mushroom villages from generation until they are fixed (prob next update)
- Changed `salt` and `distribution type` for better randomness in generation
- Fixed bug where mobs in structures can despawn before the player gets to them ([Issue #9](https://github.com/hotsu0p/Trek-Issues/issues/9))

# Compatibility update
## Technical part
- Version number changed to match [Floravive](https://modrinth.com/datapack/floravive)
- Made all in one version 1.19.x-1.21.x instead of 2 separate packs
- Added compatibility with **Floravive**, **Terralith** and **Biomes o plenty**. Now Trek structures spawn in new added biomes. If you want Trek to be compatible with another worlgen datapack/mod, you can suggest it in our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/tkyANZeXRN)
- Mushrooms from Trek moved to Floravive
- Deep dark tree temporary removed from generation as we want to find better usage for it in future
- Fixed incompatibility issue with Terralith where monster room would spawn A LOT more often in new Terralith caves
- Fixed bottom of well, so it doesnt spawn naked anymore

## New content
- Added azalea-like deep dark tree (only for 1.19x-1.20x)
- Remade mushrooms, they spawn a lot more often now

## Technical part
- Decreased overall size of all structures
- Re-done biome choosing system with tags in preparation for worldgen
- Fixed bug with hill sometimes spawning inside houses
- Adjusted rarity of structures
- Vanilla monster room now fully replaced
- Rocks, plains, wells and elven pillars moved into variations
- Started using processors for better structure generation
- Placed loot where it was not placed
- Houses on sleepy_island are filled now
- Fixed portal_sword generation, now it blends in with terrain better
- Fixed sunken_city not being fully closed
- Fixed issue with desert village house following terrain
- Villages spawn little rarer now
- Decreased amount of churches in plain villages
- Added back floating_farm_large ([issue](https://github.com/hotsu0p/Trek-Issues/issues/3) is fixed)
- Temporary removed birch ship from generation
- Deleted castle_ruins from generation
- And much more other small bugfixes
